remarks: Exceptional Downtown Apartment! RENT INCLUDES: Reserved Parking, Heat, Hot Water & Cooking Gas! Get Ready to Enjoy life in the heart of vibrant Downtown Stamford in this newly renovated 1-bedroom/1-bath apartment in a secure mid-rise building. This private, end-unit features a sunny, open flow with new flooring, a modern white kitchen and excellent storage/closet space! Located in the pulse of the city, steps from the historic Avon Theater, popular downtown restaurants, UCONN, shops, bars, the Ferguson library, and public transportation. Please: No Pets/Smoking/Vaping, good credentials a must!
